'''NEC Nijmegen''' (''Nijmegen Eendracht Combinatie''), commonly known as '''NEC''' or '''N.E.C.'''<ref name="UEFA – N.E.C. – Squad 2026–27">{{cite web |title=N.E.C. – Squad – UEFA Champions League 2026–27 |url=https://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/clubs/52330--n-e-c/squad/ |access-date=24 September 2026 |website=[[UEFA]] |language=en }}</ref> ({{IPA|nl|ɛneːˈseː}}), is a professional [[Football in the Netherlands|Dutch association football club]] based in [[Nijmegen]]. The club currently competes in the [[Eredivisie]], the top tier of [[Dutch football league system|Dutch football]].

The club has reached six [[KNVB Cup]] finals—1973, 1983, 1994, 2000, 2024 and 2026—but has never won the cup."}}
